mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_notifications (user_id, notification_type, title, body, data, locale, scheduled_at, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{body}, #{data}, #{locale}, #{scheduledAt}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE push_notifications SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, data = #{data}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM push_notifications WHERE status = 'pending' AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC LIMIT 100
